Hi Andres — thanks for flagging this. Short answer: Redwood does not request a reverse-charge entry for this type of marketplace/platform fee in Mexico; the common path is withholding by the payer where Mexican tax law or the payer's internal policy requires it. A few clarifications and next steps below so your AP can proceed: 

1) RFC and CFDI: We will provide our RFC and the CFDI UUIDs immediately (see action item 1). We also attach a human-readable stub of the invoice and will send the signed XML CFDI file on receipt of your preferred secure transfer method.

2) Withholding vs reverse-charge: For MX the typical outcome for non-resident service/platform fees is withholding by the Mexican payer when they are required to withhold IVA. Reverse-charge (sujeción inversa) is not the default mechanism for cross-border digital platform fees. That said, specific contracts and the nature of the supply can change treatment — if MexPro's tax counsel treats the charge as subject to reverse-charge, please share their written position and we will coordinate.

3) Line-level breakdown: I've asked Finance Ops to provide a CSV with the taxable base and tax amount per line so you can compute any withholding. If MexPro withholds, please provide the withholding certificate once payment is made so we can reconcile.

4) Suggested interim flow (to unblock payment this week):
  - You can record the invoice at gross (as billed) and compute withholding at the payer side if your policy calls for it.
  - If withholding applies, remit net amount and send the withholding proof; Redwood will accept a standard proof of withholding for reconciliation.
  - If MexPro requires us to issue a self-billed invoice or to reclassify the line, we can discuss a corrected CFDI but that will require legal/tax sign-off.

Action items:
  - (Kimberly) Provide RFC and CFDI UUIDs by EOD.
  - (Ben) Prepare line-level tax breakdown and CSV.
  - (Andres) Confirm whether your AP will withhold IVA or require a reverse-charge memo from counsel — if withholding, indicate the percentage your AP will apply.

I want to avoid a payment hold for administrative reasons, so we will prioritize the CFDI XML and the tax breakdown.
